Our Services

Multi-Residential Painting & Maintenance

Reliable painting and finishing services for apartment buildings and residential properties.

Heritage Commercial Interiors Inc. provides professional painting and finishing services for apartment buildings, multi-unit residential properties, and managed rental communities. From individual suite turnovers to large-scale common area improvements, we help property owners and managers maintain clean, attractive, and well-maintained living environments.

We recognize the importance of efficient scheduling, consistent workmanship, and minimizing inconvenience to residents. Whether preparing units for new tenants, refreshing shared spaces, or completing larger property improvements, our team delivers dependable results that help maintain the appearance and value of your building.

Services We Offer

  • Apartment and rental unit painting
  • Tenant turnover painting and preparation
  • Hallway, stairwell, and corridor painting
  • Lobby and common area refinishing
  • Interior and exterior building painting
  • Drywall patching and surface repairs
  • Doors, trim, and baseboard painting
  • Ongoing maintenance painting and touch-ups

Frequently Asked Questions

Heritage Commercial Interiors provides professional painting and finishing services throughout the Greater Toronto Area and Southern Ontario. We work with commercial and residential clients across the region and are available to discuss projects outside our primary service area. Contact us to learn more about availability in your location.

Heritage Commercial Interiors specializes in commercial and residential painting, exterior painting, and epoxy flooring. Our services include painting for shopping malls, retail spaces, commercial offices, apartment buildings, and homes.

Whether you're preparing a space for new tenants, refreshing an existing property, or completing a renovation, we provide professional painting and finishing solutions tailored to your project.

Yes! In addition to our commercial painting services, Heritage Commercial Interiors provides residential interior and exterior painting. Whether you're refreshing a single room, repainting your entire home, or updating your property's exterior, our team delivers quality workmanship and professional finishes with attention to detail.
